home.title: Your characters
home.empty: Your vault is empty. Every hero starts somewhere.
home.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from your vault. This can't be undone.

landing.lead: Build characters with rules that explain every choice, play them on a sheet that knows its mechanics, and roll dice with a history nobody can fake.
landing.moreSoon: More systems are on the way.

guided.title: Guided creation
guided.text: Every choice shows what it changes before you make it: scores, proficiencies, spells.

play.title: Sheets that play
play.text: Cast a spell, spend a slot, roll its damage. Rests, conditions and hit dice just work.

dice.title: Honest dice
dice.text: Rolled on the server and kept forever in a roll history your table can check.

roster.title: Your whole roster
roster.text: Portraits, backstories and every character you play, across every game, in one place.

picker.title: Create a character
picker.lead: Choose the game system first. It decides which rules, choices and sheet your character gets.
